checks.name: environment_smoke
checks.cases: Correct sequential fixture passed, deliberately wrong fixture failed, repaired fixture passed.

checks.label: initial
checks.coverage: 430 cycles: all individual bits, rising and falling transitions, sticky capture, reset priority, history across reset, synchronous reset pulse, and varied patterns with periodic resets.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
No initial register values are specified; output checks begin with synchronous reset.
implementation: Input history is sampled on every positive clock edge. Falling transitions set sticky output bits; active-high synchronous reset clears the output with priority.
